description: This file defines the Swing UI component for configuring the Hono Commander Sampler in JMeter, providing GUI elements to set connection options, command parameters, and trigger types.

classes.name: HonoCommanderSamplerUI
classes.description: Swing UI class for configuring and displaying the parameters of the Hono Commander sampler in JMeter.

methods.name: HonoCommanderSamplerUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes GUI components for the Hono Commander Sampler configuration.

methods.name: getStaticLabel
methods.description: Returns the static label of the UI component, used in JMeter for identifying the sampler.

methods.name: createTestElement
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of HonoCommanderSampler configured with current GUI settings.

methods.name: modifyTestElement
methods.description: Modifies the provided TestElement with current GUI settings to prepare it for execution.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures GUI components based on the settings of the provided TestElement.

methods.name: clearGui
methods.description: Resets all GUI components to their default or empty state.

methods.name: getTriggerTypePanel
methods.description: Creates and returns the panel for selecting trigger types and viewing descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptionTextAreaDesign
methods.description: Applies styling to a JTextArea for display purposes.

methods.name: getDescriptionTextForSelectedTrigger
methods.description: Provides descriptive text based on the current trigger type selection.
